verdict.rationale: A live probe confirms Checkout.com serves an llms.txt at its site root (HTTP 200), so an agent can be pointed at it directly. The visible content opens with a company/platform overview, so its depth as developer documentation is unproven, and a markdown docs variant (docs.md) returned 404. Missing for 10: evidence the llms.txt links or covers API/integration docs in depth, markdown or agent-oriented doc pages (docs.md 404), first-party documentation of the llms.txt, and independent or hands-on corroboration of agent use.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can point an agent at llms.txt or agent-oriented docs

citations.quote: PROBE llms.txt: HTTP 200 at https://www.checkout.com/llms.txt # Checkout.com: High-performance global payments platform for enterprise and scaling businesses
